name: Server-Side Template Injection via Dynamic Template String Evaluation
description: User-supplied template string is evaluated dynamically without sandbox isolation, allowing remote code execution.

name: Insecure XML Entity Expansion (XXE) with External Entity Resolution
description: XML parser configuration enables external entity expansion (noent: true), permitting local file retrieval and SSRF.

name: Mass Assignment / Sensitive Field Auto-Binding
description: User profile update blindly assigns request body onto user record, permitting privilege escalation.

name: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via Catastrophic Backtracking
description: Vulnerable regex with nested quantifiers evaluated on unconstrained input causes catastrophic backtracking.

name: Cryptographic Nonce / Static IV Reuse in Symmetric Encryption
description: Symmetric CBC encryption initializes cipher with fixed all-zero IV, enabling ciphertext replay and pattern analysis.

name: JWT Verification Bypass via Algorithm Confusion
description: JWT signature verification omits explicit algorithm whitelist, allowing algorithm confusion or unsigned token acceptance.

name: Zip Slip / Path Traversal in File Archive Extraction
description: Archive extraction concatenates target directory with unvalidated entry path, allowing filesystem traversal.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) with DNS Rebinding
description: Webhook endpoint fetches arbitrary user-provided URL without DNS validation or private IP network confinement.

name: HTTP Response Splitting / CRLF Injection in Header Construction
description: Set-Cookie header value constructed from unsanitized input without CRLF stripping, allowing HTTP response splitting.

name: Unprotected One-Time Token Reuse / Race Condition in Password Reset
description: Password reset token is checked and only marked used after asynchronous processing, allowing concurrent race-condition reuse.

name: Static Template Map with Parameterized Context Binding Guard
description: Template renderer restricts execution strictly to pre-compiled static templates.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces pre-compiled static template map rejecting dynamic evaluation

name: Safe XML Parser Configuration Guard
description: XML parser explicitly disables external entity resolution (noent: false) and DTD processing.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces safe XML parser configuration with noent=false and dtd=false

name: Whitelist-Based Property Extraction Guard
description: Profile mutation filters input through an explicit allowlist, preventing unintended field assignment.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces strict whitelist-based field extraction for object mutation

name: Bounded Input Length and Linear Regex Guard
description: Email validation enforces strict 254-character maximum length and uses linear polynomial regex.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces input length bound and linear regex complexity

name: Fresh Cryptographic Nonce / Random IV Guard
description: Symmetric encryption generates a fresh cryptographically random 16-byte IV for every message.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces fresh cryptographically random IV generation per encryption call

name: Pinned Algorithm Whitelist JWT Verification Guard
description: JWT verification explicitly pins the expected algorithm to RS256, rejecting algorithm confusion attacks.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces strict algorithm whitelist pinned to RS256

name: Canonical Target Path & Directory Prefix Enclosure Guard
description: Resolved path is verified to remain strictly within the extraction root directory prefix.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces canonical destination containment within directory prefix boundary

name: DNS Resolution with Private/Loopback CIDR Egress Guard
description: Webhook caller pre-resolves DNS hostname and blocks requests to private, loopback, or link-local addresses.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces pre-request DNS resolution and private/loopback IP egress barrier

name: Strict CRLF Character Rejection Header Guard
description: Input is inspected for CRLF characters and rejected prior to setting response headers.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces strict CRLF character rejection prior to header assignment

name: Atomic Token Check-and-Set Invalidation Guard
description: One-time token is checked and invalidated atomically before asynchronous password update processing.

mitigationProof.reason: Enforces atomic check-and-set invalidation before async operation
